name: security-research/version-regression-check
title: Behavioral version-regression check
description: Against an already-planned-and-started run, execute the same bounded probe twice — once representing the baseline and once the candidate — capture each as evidence, and compare the two observations deterministically. The comparison result and both evidence references are returned for validation and report material. Composes research_probe and research_compare through the governed dispatch path; the probes themselves are scope- and policy-gated.

run_id.description: An existing research run (planned and started) that owns the resulting evidence.

baseline_probe.description: The probe spec representing baseline behavior (e.g. { type: 'http', url: '...', name: 'baseline' }).

candidate_probe.description: The probe spec representing candidate behavior.

compare_mode.description: How to compare the two observations.
